quotes.text: Today we're going to do the Stroll.
The first step in the Stroll is side tap tap tap side cross.
The Stroll begins with gentlemen and ladies in two lines facing each other.

The teacher stands in front of a wooden door and speaks to the camera.
The teacher demonstrates the basic step while counting aloud.

The teacher and her partner demonstrate the dance in two lines.
